title: Skeletal muscle: twitch, summation, tetanus and fatigue
goals: Separate a stimulus marker from mechanical contraction onset
Measure latent period, contraction phase and relaxation when both axes have a validated time base
Describe changes in twitch height and duration with stimulus history
Compare fatigue with incomplete and fused tetanus using original records
sample_preparation: Frog sciatic nerve–gastrocnemius or other explicitly specified preparation, depending on original dataset
tasks: Identify changes in peak magnitude between early and late contractions without inventing absolute force
Use a calibrated example to quantify onset latency
Explain why record orientation depends on the lever/transducer geometry
List two apparatus artifacts that could mimic fatigue
interpretation_warning: Marey's 1892 scanned image is a historical teaching plate, not calibrated numerical force data. Do not treat separation of successive printed curves as a modern amplitude scale.
